name: Court of Ma'at
source:
You play as pharaoh Horem during the 18th dynasty of Egypt. You have to balance your work and home life as the living embodiment of a god, how hard could it be? What is right and wrong? Can there be an allowance for a lapse in judgment? Can you forge a path to getting to sleep peacefully each night?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4177850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演埃及第十八王朝的法老霍雷姆。作为活生生的神的化身，你必须平衡工作和家庭生活，这有多难？什么是对和错？是否可以允许判断失误？你能找到一条让每晚安然入睡的道路吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4177850/]Steam[/url]]
